rows.headline: Canara Bank revises its Marginal Cost of Funds Based Lending Rate effective November 12, 2026
rows.hook: Loan costs adjust ahead of festive season
rows.summary: Canara Bank has announced a revision to its Marginal Cost of Funds Based Lending Rate (MCLR), which will take effect on November 12, 2026. MCLR changes directly impact the interest rates on various consumer and corporate loans linked to it. Borrowers with loans tied to Canara Bank's MCLR will see adjustments in their equated monthly installments (EMIs). This routine rate change affects retail borrowers and corporate clients holding floating-rate loans with the bank.
rows.why_it_matters: Your loan EMIs tied to Canara Bank MCLR will change.

rows.headline: Brokerages highlight four high-dividend stocks for Diwali Samvat 2083
rows.summary: BPCL, Canara Bank, Hero MotoCorp, and HCL Tech have been featured in brokerage Diwali stock picks with annual dividend yields ranging from 2.72% to 3.96%. Over the past year, their dividend payments spanned from ₹4.20 per share for Canara Bank up to ₹187 per share for Hero MotoCorp. These selections highlight income-generating opportunities for investors heading into the new Hindu calendar year. Indian retail investors focusing on regular cash flows may review these high-yield names for their portfolios.
rows.why_it_matters: Identifies income stocks for your Diwali portfolio planning
rows.winners_losers: Dividend seekers gain / growth investors unaffected

rows.headline: Fredun Pharmaceuticals posts 90% jump in Q2 net profit
rows.hook: Profit nearly doubles on strong demand
rows.summary: Fredun Pharmaceuticals reported an 85% increase in revenue to ₹266 crore for the second quarter of financial year 2027. Net profit surged by 90%, driven by higher demand for its pharmaceutical products. The company's performance reflects strong quarterly growth in its core business operations. Retail investors tracking mid-cap pharma stocks can gauge improving operational margins in the sector.
rows.why_it_matters: Strong quarterly earnings signal robust demand for mid-cap pharma players.
rows.winners_losers: Fredun Pharmaceuticals gains / competitors face margin pressure
